name: notionhub
description: Sync WeRead, Flomo, GitHub, RSS, Douban, Telegram, NetEase and more into Notion via the NotionHub plugin hub.

commands.title: NotionHub: Sync Now
commands.description: Run the configured NotionHub plugins against your Notion workspace.

commands.title: NotionHub: Check Databases
commands.description: Verify every required Notion database is present and schema is correct.

commands.title: NotionHub: Show Workspace Status
commands.description: Print workspace health JSON to the output channel.

commands.title: NotionHub: List Plugins
commands.description: List all built-in NotionHub plugins and their configuration status.

commands.title: NotionHub: Open Settings
commands.description: Open the NotionHub VS Code settings page.

notionhub.pythonPath.description: Command used to invoke the NotionHub Python CLI. Must be on PATH (defaults to the installed 'notionhub' console script).

notionhub.envFile.description: Optional absolute path to a .env file passed through to the CLI as NOTIONHUB_ENV_FILE.

notionhub.workingDirectory.description: Working directory for CLI invocations. Leave empty to use the opened workspace folder.
